what: Gumroad help documentation states it costs $0 to start selling, charges a 10% flat fee per sale with no monthly payments or hidden charges, and notes that credit card and PayPal processing fees are separate.
verbatim_snippet: "It costs $0 to start selling on Gumroad, and we charge no monthly fees, seriously. When you make a sale, we charge a 10% flat fee. This does not include credit card processing or PayPal fees, but there are no monthly payments or hidden charges."
notes: help.gumroad.com requires sign-in authentication for direct access. Content extracted from Google search index cache. The mention of "PayPal fees" may be outdated as Gumroad reportedly removed PayPal support in late 2024. Dimension: fees, barrier to entry.
